items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But your brothers didn't have nicknames like that, did you? ... Wes's name, his name was...that's not his real name. His name was John Leslie.

ctx.x: But your brothers didn't have nicknames like that, did they?
Not like that, but they had nicknames. Wes's name, his name was...that's not his real name. His name was John Leslie.
Really, I didn't know that. Buddy, I know, is Charles.
